physDesc.additional: Script: 'bru tsha. Lines per folio: 10; 3 on fol. 48b. Orthography: - bindu for -m - abbreviations (e.g., for slob dpon, thams cad, etc.) - Numerals used for numbers and phonetic value Annotations with "+" signs and dotted lines on fols. 21b1, 28a1, 29b1, 35a1, 37a1,, 38a1, 40a9, etc. Numbers in annotations on fols. 36b10-37a1 to count items in a list. Numbers in the top margin on fol. 40a. Proofread (1 zhus dag par byas so).

body.ab:
rnal 'byor spyod pa'i sa las byang chub spyod pa'i sa zhes pa theg pa chen po'i mdo sde brgya mtsho lta bu rnams las byang chub sems dpa'i bslab pa'i gnas mchog du gces pa ma lus par bsdus pa | rin pa che'i bang mdzod chen po lta bu lam dang 'bras bu 'i cha thams cad ma tshang pa med par ston pa sde snod kyi ma lta bur gyur pa 'di bshad pa'ipa‹'›i
tshul la ¦ kho bo'i bla ma kha cig gleng gzhi bstan pa dang ¦ dgos pa brjod pa dang× don gyis khog dbub pa dang ¦ dkyus kyis sa gcad pa dang ¦ tshig gi 'bru gnan pa lngas bshad par bya'o zhes gsung pa 'am |
yang na mkhas pa'i shes rab dang ¦ brtse ba'i bsam pa dang ¦ sbyor ba'i bzod pa dang ldan pa gsum gyis 'chad pa'ipa‹'›i chos dang | don bstan pa dang ¦ tshig bshad pa dang ¦ brgal lan gyis nges par bya bas bshad
thabs kyi yan lag dang | chos dang ¦ gdul bya dang ¦ 'jug pa'i dbang gis ji ltar bshad pas bshad pa'i tshul dang gsum gyis bshad par bya'o zhes gsung pa bzhin du shes par bya'o ||
1 zhus dag par byas so | dag par byung ngo ||
